evals.rule_under_test: Every debug session produces a note at docs/incidents/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md
evals.prompt: A failing test in feature F002: 'expected 429 status, got 200'. Debug it.
evals.expected_output: Skill investigates, identifies cause, and writes the investigation to docs/incidents/2026-MM-DD-f002-429-status.md (or similar slug). The note covers symptom, repro, root cause, fix.

assertions.name: incident file created
assertions.check: A new file exists under docs/incidents/ matching the date+slug convention.

assertions.name: all four sections present
assertions.check: Note contains Symptom, Reproduction, Root cause, and Fix sections.

evals.rule_under_test: If a bug invalidates an ADR assumption, the ADR's Consequences section must be updated
evals.prompt: Bug discovered: vendored SKILL.md was modified outside the 2 allowed edits, but the script didn't detect it. This breaks ADR-0009's assumption that 'allowed edits are enforced'. Debug and resolve.
evals.expected_output: Skill writes incident note. Identifies ADR-0009 as having an invalidated assumption ('allowed edits are enforced' was wishful — actual enforcement is manual). Appends a dated bullet to ADR-0009's Consequences section noting the gap.

assertions.name: ADR-0009 Consequences updated
assertions.check: docs/decisions/0009-harness-delta-sidecar.md gains a new bullet under Consequences referencing the discovered gap.

assertions.name: incident note links to ADR
assertions.check: Incident note explicitly references ADR-0009 by number.

evals.rule_under_test: Production incidents must surface harness:canary for rollback planning
evals.prompt: Production alert: 5xx error rate spike on /api/checkout. Debug.
evals.expected_output: Skill recognizes this as a production incident (not dev/test). Begins investigation AND prompts user about harness:canary for rollback planning.

assertions.name: canary surfaced
assertions.check: Output explicitly asks the user about harness:canary.
